name: Dreadsite Survival
detailed_description:
Gameplay Features:

Looting and Defensive Structures

  • Scavenge abandoned homes and structures for weapons, supplies, and materials.

  • Fortify buildings to defend yourself and your team against zombie hordes and hostile players.

Survival Essentials: Food and Water

  • Hunting: Track and hunt wildlife to obtain meat.

  • Farming: Grow crops for a steady food supply.

  • Foraging: Gather wild plants and berries.

  • Water Sources: Find and purify water to stay hydrated.

Multiple Perspectives

  • Third-Person View: Offers a wider field of vision for tactical gameplay.

  • True First-Person View: Enhances immersion and precision in combat.

Vehicles and Mechanics

  • Drivable Vehicles: Use cars, trucks, and other vehicles for faster travel.

  • Maintenance: Repair and refuel vehicles to keep them operational.

XP and Skill Leveling System

  • Gain XP by defeating enemies, crafting items, and completing tasks.

  • Unlock Skills: Improve combat, survival, and crafting abilities.

Character Weather State Effects

  • Dynamic Weather Impact: Cold, rain, and storms affect your character’s health and stamina.

  • Clothing and Shelter: Find or craft appropriate gear to survive harsh conditions.

Character Attribute States

  • Manage various health conditions:

    • Healthy: Optimal state.

    • Wounded: Reduced movement and combat ability.

    • Sick: Requires medicine to prevent progression.

    • Infected: Time-sensitive treatment needed.

    • Poisoned: Find antidotes to survive.

    • Drunk: Temporary stat debuffs.

    • Fatigued: Rest to regain stamina.

    • Bleeding: Requires bandages to stop health loss.

    • Stunned: Briefly incapacitated during combat.

Crafting, Building, and Raiding

  • Crafting: Create weapons, tools, medical supplies, and fortifications.

  • Building: Construct safe houses or bases with walls, traps, and defenses.

  • Raiding: Attack enemy camps for valuable resources.

Dynamic Weather and Day/Night Cycles

  • Weather Effects: Rain, fog, and storms influence visibility and mobility.

  • Day/Night Cycle: Darkness increases stealth but also raises danger levels.

8K Open World Environment

  • Explore an expansive and detailed 8K open-world filled with abandoned cities, forests, and hidden secrets.


These features create a comprehensive and immersive survival experience, challenging players to manage resources, defend against threats, and explore a dangerous post-apocalyptic world.

Dreadsite Survival is an 8K Open World Multiplayer Online Survival Game set in a post-apocalyptic landscape, developed and published by Xi Studios. Four years after the fall of civilization, you’ll navigate a world overrun by infected hordes and battle for survival. Form alliances or go solo as you face not only the relentless undead but also hostile rogue drifters who will stop at nothing to take what you have. Do you have what it takes to survive?

In a world where possessions are worth more than gold, survival demands more than just grit. Scavenge for raw materials and vital supplies, trade cautiously with those you trust, and craft essential items to endure the darkness. Build self-sustaining, off-grid bases to shield yourself from relentless dangers—both the infected and the living. In this post-apocalyptic open world, every corner hides a threat or an opportunity. Will you thrive, or will the shadows claim you?

Gathering raw materials and supplies is a crucial aspect of crafting in Dreadsite Survival. Utilize tools such as axes, pickaxes, and crowbars to harvest resources from trees, rocks, and abandoned vehicles scattered throughout the world. Make the most of your time by collecting materials whenever you're not actively facing threats.

In the struggle to rebuild society amidst a collapsed civilization, establishing an Off-Grid Base is the first crucial step. Each location on the map offers its own unique advantages and disadvantages, making it essential to explore thoroughly before committing to a specific site. Whether you choose to construct modest outposts or sprawling fortified compounds, the choice is yours. Adapt and expand strategically to survive and thrive in the world of Dreadsite Survival.

In a world overrun by the infected, hostile NPCs, and ruthless enemy players, survival demands more than just grit—it demands unity. Team up with other survivors to navigate dangerous territories, secure valuable resources, and defend your base against relentless threats.

Are you ready to face the awakening apocalypse? Do you have what it takes to thrive—not just survive?

short_description: In Dreadsite Survival, players awaken in a world destroyed by a mysterious cataclysm. Surrounded by infected hordes and ruthless drifters, they must scavenge, build, and fight to survive, uncovering the secrets of the apocalypse while battling to stay alive.
supported_languages:
English*, German
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit Operating System
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4170 or AMD FX-8120
  • Graphics: 8 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 18 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DX11 compatible
  • Additional Notes: With these requirements, it is recommended that the game is played on Low quality settings.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit Operating System
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4170 or AMD FX-8300 or higher
  • Graphics: 16 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 18 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DX12 compatible
  • Additional Notes: With these requirements, it is recommended that the game is played on Epic quality settings.
